mechanism: Clonazepam may increase CNS depression risk, and both drugs can affect renal function and electrolyte balance; zoledronic acid may potentiate benzodiazepine effects through cumulative CNS depression and metabolic alterations.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and renal function; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; adjust clonazepam dose if needed based on clinical response.
